title: February 26 Monstra-case protest — subsequent-month separate-episode boundary
notes: CIVICUS explicitly describes another protest after the final ruling on Feb26, with clashes/arrests; Telegrafi search result also dates its report to Feb26. Shared Monstra grievance does not establish a continuous assembly. Do not transfer later protest clashes, arrests, charges or other responses to Jan29 E001. The Helsinki Committee's March report also recalls Jan29 as the prior protest and separately describes Feb26; thematic/repeated grievance does not imply physical continuity.
